approval_required_for: Any change to Qwen2 decoder operator order or stage boundary grouping.
Any change to residual skip topology, MLP branch/join topology, pairing_key semantics, or transfer_order semantics.
Any change to GQA head mapping, including num_q_heads, num_kv_heads, gqa_group_size, head_dim, causal flag, RoPE policy, or seq_len_bound.
Any change to tensor width contracts for hidden_size=896, intermediate_size=4864, or seq_len=16.
Any replacement of trusted template bindings with new templates or free-form RTL obligations.
Any numeric policy or memory-layout change, which is outside this role and requires the appropriate specialist approval.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote to aggregate evidence gate. Map each violation to constraint.model.decoder, constraint.shape.model, constraint.template.library, or constraint.cross_layer.input_consistency, then invoke bounded pipeline repair without editing golden outputs or introducing free-form RTL.
executable_actions.rationale: Package and verify the model-shape audit evidence for decoder order, residual and branch semantics, GQA values, tensor shapes, stream order, and no free-form RTL using the named acceptance checkers before evidence-gate promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Return to pipeline_planning bounded repair or template-selection review with the violated SACG constraint; do not generate code and do not substitute a free-form RTL implementation.
executable_actions.rationale: Stage 4 must bind the reviewed plan into template parameters while preserving the GQA head mapping, seq_len bound, residual paths, branch/join keys, stream order, and tensor widths; this action is static binding and does not claim RTL or hardware correctness.

executable_actions.on_failure: Open a stage_retry_request or stage_backtrack_request and block promotion. Do not bypass checkers, change golden outputs, loosen tolerance, or introduce unapproved RTL/template changes.
executable_actions.rationale: If the evidence-gate or Stage 4 static binding detects a semantic, shape, attention, residual-path, or template-boundary violation, repair must stay inside the trusted operator-stream pipeline contract and rerun the named checkers.

observations: Supplied SACG memory state reports zero active contamination barriers, zero open retry requests, and zero open backtrack requests; state_summary.failed_invariants is empty.

The candidate records checker_summary passed=10, failed=0, with no warnings or errors. Relevant visible passes include operator_order_check, stream_data_edge_mirror_check, edge_stream_contract_check, shape_numeric_contract_check, branch_join_contract_check, liveness_backpressure_check, attention_semantics_check, and template_binding_static_check.
The stage sequence matches the required Qwen2 decoder-block order: rms_norm_1, self_attention, residual_add_1, rms_norm_2, mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, activation_mul, mlp_down_proj, residual_add_2.

Residual_add_1 joins the original block_input residual skip with the self_attention main output. Residual_add_2 joins the residual_add_1 output skip with the mlp_down_proj main output. Both joins use pairing_key token/tile/lane/word and fire only when all required inputs are valid.

The MLP branch contract duplicates rms_norm_2 output atomically to gate and up branches through ready_valid_broadcast_with_per_output_fifo, then activation_mul joins gate and up streams on token/tile/lane/word. This preserves the planned gated-MLP branch/join semantics at the stream-contract level.

The attention contract is internally consistent with hidden width 896: num_q_heads=14, num_kv_heads=2, gqa_group_size=7, head_dim=64, and 14*64=896. The contract also records causal=true, RoPE with rope_theta=1000000.0, and seq_len_bound=16.

Tensor shapes are consistent across the visible plan: hidden streams use seq_len=16,width=896; MLP intermediate streams use seq_len=16,width=4864; all stream_edges mirror data_edges and use transfer_order token/tile/lane/word with full_beats_only policy.

Element widths follow the supplied numeric stream contract boundaries: 32-bit block/residual outputs, 16-bit norm/FFN intermediate streams, and 32-bit residual add outputs. This role did not change numeric policy.

Stage boundaries remain template-bound rather than free-form RTL: template_binding_static_check reports stages=9 and free_form_rtl_generation=false, with stages mapped to norm, attention, residual, ffn, and elementwise templates.

The logical self_attention stage boundary explicitly covers QKV projection, RoPE, causal GQA attention, and output projection for planning. Later parameter binding must preserve this boundary without inventing extra free-form RTL obligations.

The liveness_backpressure_check pass only establishes acyclic directed graph structure with bounded FIFO elasticity and backpressure; it is not latency-equality, throughput, timing, simulator, synthesis, or board evidence.
proposed_actions: Handoff this report to pipeline_planning.evidence_gate_auditor and run or reconcile the named acceptance checkers sacg_static_check, model_config_check, stream_plan_check, and template_binding_static_check against the candidate artifact before aggregate promotion.

Freeze the reviewed GQA contract in Stage 4 parameter binding: num_q_heads=14, num_kv_heads=2, gqa_group_size=7, head_dim=64, causal=true, RoPE theta=1000000.0, seq_len_bound=16, hidden width=896, and intermediate width=4864.

Freeze residual and branch/join pairing semantics in Stage 4: token/tile/lane/word pairing keys, all-required-inputs-valid joins, atomic split duplication, and ready/valid bounded FIFO behavior must be preserved.

If any named acceptance checker fails, perform bounded pipeline_repair only within the operator-stream/template contract; do not edit golden outputs, loosen tolerances, bypass checkers, or introduce free-form RTL.

Do not modify numeric policy or memory address layout from this role. Treat memory/runtime details as downstream handoff obligations unless a checker reports a current-stage cross-layer inconsistency.

No hardware, simulator, synthesis, timing, or board correctness is evidenced by this Stage 3 model-shape review; symbolic_first_order latency must not be consumed as hardware pass evidence.

No active SACG memory blockers are present in the supplied state. This is a model-shape planning review only; it does not claim simulator, synthesis, timing, or board pass evidence.
